name: fix_go_zip_slip_path_traversal
description: Fixes a zip-slip path traversal: archive entries are extracted with no containment check against the destination directory
prompts: Extract(zipPath string, destDir string) error in extractor.go unpacks a zip archive into destDir, but it joins destDir with each entry's Name and writes there with NO containment check - a malicious entry whose name contains ".." components (a "zip slip", e.g. "sub/../../evil.txt") can resolve to a path OUTSIDE destDir and overwrite arbitrary files. Fix Extract so that for every entry it computes the resolved target path and verifies it is still contained within destDir (comparing the cleaned target against the cleaned destDir with a proper path-separator boundary, or using filepath.Rel and checking the result does not start with "..") - if an entry would escape destDir, return an error and do not write it (or anything after it). Legitimate entries, including ones in subdirectories, must still extract normally with their exact content. Keep the function signature.
